comparison.objective: Place four landing-zone corner beacons at least 100 ft apart and a fifth upwind.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-area beacon transport and layout, not fastener manipulation or response-driven fine adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Beacon spacing and upwind placement versus two repeatable physically damped carriage cycles.
comparison.reason: This tests surveying/layout and directional reasoning, not damper commissioning.
